mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Log off a leftover SAP session so that its locks are released.

description: [read-only] Logs off a leftover SAP session (any role), releasing every lock it holds; only the logoff is sent, credential-free. Its record is deleted afterwards. Runs outside batch mode.

handle.description: The handle of a leftover session, as the list answers it.

name: HandlerLeftoverSessionLogoff
